description: Public-readable HMT&C threshold surface for the Ask the Index chatbot. The chatbot does not retrieve from wiki/certification/ directly (per CLAUDE.md Part 2 firewall); it reads this file instead. Each entry names the metal, the product/matrix scope, the HMT&C threshold value, the labeled rationale (precautionary / market-ratcheting / feasibility-driven / regulatory-alignment), the comparable regulatory limits, and a link to the public methodology page that explains how HMT&C arrived at the value. Entries are added as HMT&C threshold-setting work completes per CLAUDE.md Part 19. Empty entries are fine; the chatbot answers 'HMT&C threshold: in development' for combinations not yet covered.

thresholds.fda_basis: FDA Closer to Zero action level, as-consumed basis
thresholds.comparable_limits_note: FDA action level finalized 2023; EU and Codex have no infant-rice-cereal-specific limit beyond broader Cd/iAs frameworks.

thresholds.fda_basis: FDA Closer to Zero draft guidance for processed baby foods, as-consumed basis
thresholds.eu_basis: EU 2023/915 maximum level for foods for infants and young children
thresholds.comparable_limits_note: FDA draft guidance 2024; EU regulation 2023/915 binding.

thresholds.eu_basis: EU 2023/915 maximum level for chocolate with >=50% total dry cocoa solids
thresholds.comparable_limits_note: FDA has no specific limit; EU regulation 2023/915 binding; California Prop 65 case-by-case settlements have set effective limits in litigation contexts.

rationale_vocabulary.precautionary: Threshold tighter than literature floor because vulnerable populations, cumulative exposure, or uncertainty warrant a safety margin beyond minimum-effect-level data.
rationale_vocabulary.market-ratcheting: Threshold tighter than literature floor because the certification program's purpose is to move the market toward cleaner product; the threshold is a policy choice, not an assertion about where toxicological effects begin.
rationale_vocabulary.feasibility-driven: Threshold looser than literature floor because current analytical methods, supply chain realities, or achievable agricultural practice do not yet support the tighter value. Paired with a sunset plan to tighten as feasibility improves.
rationale_vocabulary.regulatory-alignment: Threshold matches an external regulatory framework (FDA, EU, Codex) for commercial or legal reasons, whether or not that framework aligns with the literature.
